annual_report_2025: Northwind Logistics reported total revenue of 412 million dollars for the fiscal year 2025. Operating margin for the same period was 14 percent. The company operates 38 distribution centres across the region.
policy_returns: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days.
handbook_leave: Employees accrue 21 days of annual leave per calendar year. Unused leave may be carried forward up to a maximum of 5 days. Leave requests require approval from the reporting manager.
product_specs: The Halcyon 400 pump delivers a maximum flow rate of 55 litres per minute. Its operating pressure range is 2 to 9 bar. The unit weighs 12 kilograms.
